column1: #   cp config/samples.example.csv config/samples.csv
# config/samples.csv is gitignored (it belongs to your analysis
# repo). Rows starting with '#' are ignored.
# Columns (order matters):
#   sample        unique sample name (no spaces)
#   fastq_1       read 1 / single-end fastq(.gz); absolute path or relative
#                 to the repo root (where you run snakemake from)
#   fastq_2       read 2 fastq(.gz); leave empty for single-end. Paired and
#                 single-end samples can be mixed.
#   strandedness  per-sample override: auto
#                 or TEtranscripts' "no". Blank = auto (RSeQC detection).
#   condition     biological group label. Include it to run TEtranscripts
#                 differential analysis (one contrast per pair of distinct
#                 groups); omit/blank it to only quantify counts.
# Lane/run merging (nf-core/rnaseq style): a sample sequenced across
# multiple lanes or runs is written as one row PER fastq file pair
# the SAME sample name (see sampleA_rep1 below). Those files are
# concatenated into one fastq per read before trimming/alignment. Within one
# sample
column2: every row must agree on strandedness and condition
